notes.title: Royal Chronicles
notes.content:
Hello, friends!
Today, we want to share some interim results of the Cardigan's Mystery and talk about our plans. Let’s get started!


Key Event
At the end of August, an updated version of the Cardigan's Mystery launched. This year, our team developed a new activity where players must hide from the dangerous Soul Keeper in the Minotaur’s Labyrinth. Sure thing, there’s a reward!

The event started off with a few hiccups: in the first days when the Mystery launched, there were issues related to daily quests. The developers took action to fix the bug and compensated for the missed Questles and rewards from the Minotaur’s Labyrinth quest.

We’re also receiving feedback from our players about issues with the Groppy Metal Detector and the Sack of Powder. If you encounter this issue:

— Try returning to the character selection menu and re-entering the game.

— To reduce the chances of an issue to appear, complete and claim the reward for the quests only if you have successfully finished both.





[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109218/91d19245b1a8a6912d93abc460f27b85267de9d2.png"]
A few important reminders:
— Event consumables, namely: Alchemical Lockpicks, Otherland Coins and Mechanic's Ominous Seals will be removed from the game when the event ends. Make sure to use them in time!

— Remember that you need to claim your Seasonal Adventure rewards manually and on time to avoid losing them. 

— And, on a happy note, the annual Cardigan's Mystery event has been extended until September 30!


[hr][/hr]What has the Card of the Dark Carabus ever done to you?!
We have closely reviewed your feedback on the balance changes to the Seals and the Card of the Dark Carabus. Thank you for sharing with us!

We want to make it clear: these current changes are an essential first step in rebalancing the game. We deliberately started with elements that objectively required immediate attention.

This is just the beginning of a long journey. Our shared goal is to create a truly balanced and fair gameplay experience.

Stay tuned for updates and please keep sharing your thoughts. Your feedback is a key part of this process.


[hr][/hr]You’ve previously asked us several questions:
What can we expect in the near future?

— At the end of the month, we’re planning another round of rebalancing (we’ll share details in a separate post). We’re also implementing a promo code system. All players will definitely receive gift codes on the day when the feature goes live! And much more, which we’ll reveal in future notes.

Are there plans for in-game interactions with players through events? (Hide and seek, fighting evil bosses, etc.) 

~ We are working on game activities that the community will enjoy. Stay tuned!

When will repairs to the defensive walls in Varlone be finished?
~ The military engineers are not sure. But we did spot some new Ashkalot construction in Varlone. What do you think it is?

There’s a “Have an idea!” section on the Royal Quest fan forum. Does the RQ team read it? Maybe some ideas have already been borrowed from there?
~ Absolutely, and not only from there. Ideas, as well as feedback, are read and processed by the team and, if possible and appropriate, are implemented.

Will there be unicorns in the game? Rumor has it they make any game 20% cooler.
~ In the magical world of Aura, nothing is impossible!
[hr][/hr]
And with that, this devblog episode comes to a close. Share your impressions, feelings and questions!

See you in Royal Quest!

notes.title: The Cardigan Mystery 2025 Event: Guide
notes.content:
Friends, from August 28 to September 30, a mysterious event will unfold in Royal Quest Online — Cardigan's Mystery 2025!
To make sure you don’t miss anything and gather all the valuable rewards, we’ve prepared a short guide to the main activities of the festival.

1. What’s the first step to join the event?

When you log into the game, all players will receive a new quest in their Quest Journal: “Mysterious Scroll: New Parts.” Head to Omnis by the fountain in Varlone — he will explain what’s happening and send you to Guard Harvest in the Illayr location.

There you’ll gain access to the Otherland Tricks Seasonal Adventure.

2. What is the Otherland Tricks Seasonal Adventure?

It’s a special mechanic with 2 progression tracks: free and extended.

• The free track of the Seasonal Adventure is available to all heroes participating in the event.
• The extended track of the Seasonal Adventure is available for 2,990 Reales.


What do you get for completing the "Otherland Tricks" Seasonal Adventure?

1. By progressing through the free track you’ll receive over 50 rewards, including the unique pet Tik-tak-click, the mount Psyvider, the Gold Magnetic Collar, and a Crystal Key!
2. In the extended version of the Seasonal Adventure, you’ll find all the rewards from the free version, plus dozens of useful items and skins — including the Cardi K Tranzample Set (designed by Alice, Dumpty, and Hatter for the new Cardigan's Mystery emcee, but alas, it didn’t work out), the cunning pet called Twofacer, and the Tor Toise’s Sealing Wax.

To access the treasures of the Otherland Tricks Seasonal Adventure, you’ll need special progression points called Questles. How do you earn them and what do they unlock? Read below!

3. How do you enter Otherland?

Where maps end and the borders of reality fade lies Otherland — the location where the main action takes place and the main characters of the Cardigan's Mystery dwell.

You can enter the celebration via the Seasonal Adventure icon on the Character Panel, then press Travel to Bunny — and Baron Cardigan’s magic will send you into Otherland.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109218/f315756345de1271a719325038d901b1f7381c7b.png"]

 4. What can you do in Otherland?

Every day in Otherland you’ll find important tasks from its unusual residents: Alice, Dumpty, Li Si Tsyn and Hatter. Completing each daily quest will grant you an Alchemical Lockpick — a magic key that opens paths to the most hidden corners of Otherland. Without them, even the bravest travelers won’t be able to advance.

Completing these heroes’ quests will also grant you Otherland Coins — currency glowing with the light of distant planets. You can exchange them in Bunny’s updated shop for unique pets, accessories, costumes and recipes.


Don’t forget to visit the Backstage attraction! The Absurd Caskets hold the most coveted prizes.

5. Daily Activities (reset at 00:00 UTC)

With the new series of daily quests “Otherland Organization,” you’ll earn progress points for the Seasonal Adventure. 

Complete quests to collect progression points for the Seasonal Adventure. The more quests you finish, the better the rewards. Test your agility and speed by catching flamingos, and your wit and courage in the hunt for Lord Boil!

The number of Seasonal Adventure points per day is limited. To reach the final level, don’t forget to log in and complete quests regularly.

6. New Mechanic — The Minotaur’s Labyrinth  Alice has prepared a special trial — dangerous but rich in rewards:

Collect lost souls in the depths of the Twisted Garden;

Unlock cursed chests with rare trophies;

get Questles for completion.

Only the cleverest and bravest will trick the vigilant Minotaur and carry out the souls! The rest will remain in the labyrinth forever...

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109218/e4c011cfe768939314d1cd3a93d0f992f80e9de6.png"]
Good luck solving the Cardigan's Mysteries, hero! 

If you have any problems or questions about the event, ask them on social media or contact our Support Team.

Every detail of this little one appealed to him: from the impeccably chosen elements of the outfit to the aura of whimsy with a pinch of madness that surrounded them. notes.title: August 28 Update
notes.content:
Greetings, heroes! As of the August 28, 2025 update, here’s what will change in the game:

Game Events

— The Cardigan's Mystery 2025 event has been launched.
— Within this activity, players will have access to the Otherland Tricks Seasonal Adventure, featuring over fifty rewards. You can read more about the event in our article via the link:

New Features in Cardigan's Mystery 2025:

— You can now move to Otherland by clicking the Seasonal Adventure icon on the Character Panel. Then click the Teleport to Bunny button;
— The character Bunny is now located only in Otherland and has been removed from Varlone;
— The questline now begins after visiting Omnis at the fountain in Varlone. Access to the Seasonal Adventure is granted by Guard Harvest in Illayr;
— Added the activity Minotaur’s Labyrinth. You can visit the fearsome monster by taking the quest “Soulful Tread》 from Alice;
— Added the Baron’s Chest. It appears randomly and contains random useful items. The search for the chest begins after taking the quest “Baron’s Manners》 from Bunny;
— Added Lord Boil. This event boss appears in Illayr, Elgore, Iris and Quedock. You can go hunt him by taking the quest “Boiling with Indignation》 from Bunny;
— Added the questline “Otherland Organization》;
— The Bunny’s shop has been changed.

Balance  Based on player feedback and analytics, the characteristics of the following Seals have been changed: Seal of the Fiend, Seal of Caligula, Seal of Madness, Seal of the Cardinal’s Robe, Seal of the Ritual Scorpion, Seal of Meditation, Seal of the Old Shoemaker, Seal of the Warrior Ant, Seal of the Brain Racker, Seal of the Dancing Forest, Seal of the Lunatic, Seal of Resourceful Jones. Also there was a change in characteristics of the Card of the Dark Carabus. These changes affect not only Seals and Cards obtained after the update but also all existing ones.

notes.title: Important Note!
notes.content:
Defenders of Elenia, Welcome!
A week has passed since the transition to the new version of the server architecture, and we would like to summarize the interim results.

Let's start with things that are not so noticeable to players, although they constitute an important part of how the game works:

Regional servers are now isolated, so that any issues in one region no longer affect the others;

Character selection screen is loading faster now;

Stability of the overall system and individual services (game chat, guild chat, loading of individual locations) has been improved.
[hr][/hr]
Can you recall how this transition started with two stages of the Open Beta Test? More than half of the active players took part in testing the new system and searching for errors!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109218/a417bf53ddec769345877e65bb97dca76d6f06e4.png"]
[hr][/hr]
It is worth noting that after the transition to the new system, a number of unpleasant issues occurred—from unscheduled maintenance last Friday (an error occurred on July 18, which was not related to the architecture changes) to individual malfunctions for some users. Among them:

Players detected incorrect duration when activating Premium Account;

Some character skills were reset;

Players couldn’t assign traders and so on.

We did our best to fix these issues this Wednesday, July 23.

At the moment, we can see that the issues for the majority of players have been resolved, but for some they still persist. We continue investigating this situation and would greatly appreciate it if you inform us in the comments or through Support Team whether you are still experiencing any of the difficulties listed above. Your feedback is very helpful for the game’s development!
[hr][/hr]
In conclusion, we would like to share two more things:

Fixes for errors related to Zatras’ Totem and game crashes while dismounting have been passed to our QA for testing;

Starting from 13:00 (UTC) on July 25 until 20:59 (UTC) on July 27, the Royal Inspiration bonus will be activated on all servers, giving +50% Loot Drop chance and +50% Experience.
[hr][/hr]
That's all for today. Let us know, have the recent fixes helped you or maybe some unresolved issues still remain? It will help us evaluate the effectiveness of the changes made. We wish you good luck in the game with bonus rewards!

Thank you for being with us! See you all in Royal Quest!

Hey friend, from April 10th to April 29th, get ready for a massive event—The Sky Fair in Royal Quest! In this guide, we’ll quickly break down how you can make the most of the event and snag as many rewards as possible.

How do I get to the Sky Fair?

What can I do at the Sky Fair?

Complete Baxter's quest to get a special event item and unlock the "Unbridled Fun" Seasonal Adventure.

What is "Unbridled Fun"?

It’s a unique mechanic with two progress bars: free and premium. The free part of Seasonal Adventure is available to all heroes who have met the mentioned conditions. As for the premium part, there are 4 ways to unlock it:

1. Automatically unlock it for free if you have the "Mysterious Ancient Scroll" item from Saint Vallen’s Day;
2. Purchase access for 2,990 Reales (in-game currency) through the Seasonal Adventure window;
3. Purchase the "Unbridled Fun: Elite Access" item from the Store for 2,990 Reales (can be sold at the auction house).
4. Purchase "Unbridled Fun: Elite Access" using in-game gold from other players at the auction house.

What rewards can I get for completing "Unbridled Fun"?

For completing Seasonal Adventure’s Free Version, you'll earn over 50 rewards including: Mechanosaur, Rune of Preservation, Arconite Sealing Wax, Card of Fire and much more!
2. In Seasonal Adventure’s Premium Version, you'll get all the rewards from the free version plus: Aurora (pet), "Bordeaux" tranzample set, 10 Crystal Keys and other rewards!
3. As part of the "Unbridled Fun" Seasonal Adventure, players can also earn a special currency called “Fair Cards” from the Seasonal Adventure rewards. You can exchange these with class mentors for weapon tranzamples.

To unlock rewards within the "Unbridled Fun" Season, heroes need to earn special progression points called “Questles”. Read more to learn how to get them!

notes.title: Urgent information
notes.content:
Dear Friends!
The upcoming game release on the scheduled release date has been jeopardized.
Today we received a request from the service of Steam, which checks games before release. Their request concerned the possibility of making in-game payments in Royal Quest (one of the necessary requirements for the release). This feature is available in the game and has already been checked by Steam employees, but for some reason additional data was required. And according to Steam rules, until the Steam platform receives all the requested information, the release on the platform is blocked.

It would appear that this is not a big deal. We have the data confirming the ability to accept and process payments in the game via Steam; we have already sent it in response to the request we received today. But the Steam team will be able to review this data on Monday at the earliest - within the framework of the working schedule, which implies working only on weekdays. 

The situation is aggravated by the time zone difference. We received the request today - when it was already Saturday, it was Friday evening in the Steam team office. If we get a positive answer on Monday (Steam team's local time), we will have Monday-Tuesday night.

In the morning we had a team discussion of all possible scenarios of the situation. The conclusions are as follows:
1.	The most optimistic option. On Monday morning our data is reviewed by the Steam team; they make sure that all the data is correct; the release on October 22 is allowed again. Our plans do not change: in the late evening of 21.10.24 we inform you that the release will take place on time; we hold the release on 22.10.24.
2.	Less optimistic option. On Monday afternoon our data starts to be studied by Steam team, they ask clarifying questions; gradually they make sure that all data is correct; they allow the release, but we have no time to hold it on October 22. In this case, we set the nearest date and inform you about it; the release is moved to 23.10.24 or 24.10.24.
3.	Pessimistic option. Our request is being studied by Steam team not since Monday. The official position of Steam platform: the answer can be given within 3-5 working days. In this case, we inform you about the situation and together we wait for the request to be approved. Once the request is approved, we set a release date for the nearest weekday and inform you about it.

Now from the raw facts to the personal: we are very unhappy with the situation that has arisen, for which there was no obvious precondition, but even more upset for you. We are well aware of the expectations and engagement many people have for Royal Quest. We know that some players have been taking time off for the release on Steam and have been putting together and reorganizing guilds. So, we will be working hard to keep the release on track or push it back as little as possible. 

We have already changed the release date from October 1 to October 22, realizing that the game still has a lot to prepare for the launch on Steam. But (!) more than two weeks ago the game was sent to the Steam platform team for pre-release testing, and we responded to all their requests in a timely manner, time after time confirming that all the platform requirements were met. It will be the same now, only time and human factor are against us.
